title: Why Overthinking Destroys Your Health (1981-02-06)
description:
Do you constantly plan, think, and rush through life? Discover how this mental habit damages your 'speedometer' organ and leads to serious illness, and learn the simple technique to restore balance.

This public program focuses on the Swadishthana Chakra and the dangerous effects of excessive thinking and planning on the physical body. Shri Mataji explains the spiritual causes behind modern diseases like diabetes, blood cancer, and heart attacks, linking them to the 'right side' imbalance. The talk culminates in a practical exercise to raise the left side energy and a guided self-realization experience.

Key Topics:
• 🌙 Swadishthana Chakra - how converting fat cells for brain activity depletes your vital organs
• 🔬 The 'Speedometer' (Spleen) - why rushing and reading bad news while eating causes blood cancer
• 🩺 The spiritual reason why intellectuals and planners are prone to diabetes and heart attacks
• 💸 Why money and God don't mix - exposing the commercialization of spirituality and fake gurus
• ⚡ Guided energy adjustment - technique to raise the left side followed by self-realization experience

“She is your individual Mother. You do not share Her motherhood with anybody else. She is the one who has loved you all your life and She's anxiously waiting for a moment when She can give your second birth.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi
